findings.title: SQL command construction path is not disabled by feature gate
findings.body: UnmarshalSQLCommand still creates a SQLCommand via NewSQLCommand without checking whether SQL expressions are disabled. In this PR the operation fails only because the new sql.DB stub returns 'not implemented' from TablesList/RunCommands. If a real DB implementation is reintroduced, or TablesList is changed to succeed, this entry point would allow SQL expressions despite the guard added in ExpressionQueryReader.ReadQuery. The disablement should be enforced in NewSQLCommand/UnmarshalSQLCommand or the SQL path should be removed.

findings.title: enableSqlExpressions logic is inverted and always returns false
findings.body: enableSqlExpressions sets enabled to the negation of FlagSqlExpressions and then returns false in both branches. The feature toggle therefore has no effect and the code does not communicate that SQL expressions are intentionally hard-disabled. A future change could easily misread this and accidentally re-enable the feature. If the intent is permanent disablement, return false unconditionally or remove the toggle; if the toggle should matter, fix the condition.

findings.title: No automated regression test for disabled SQL expressions
findings.body: The PR disables SQL expressions to address CVE-2024-9264 but adds no unit test asserting that QueryTypeSQL queries are rejected and that SQL command execution cannot reach a database implementation. Because this is a security boundary, an automated test is needed to prevent accidental re-enablement when dependencies or parsing code change.

findings.title: NoData result is immediately overwritten by TableData
findings.body: In Execute, when frame.Rows()==0, rsp.Values is set to mathexp.NoData, but the following unconditional assignment replaces it with mathexp.TableData. The no-data branch therefore has no effect. This is currently masked because the stubbed DB returns an error before reaching this code, but if SQL execution is ever restored, zero-row results will be returned as table data instead of NoData.
